title: Rotate left
prompt: Implement `static int[] RotateLeft(int[] values, int k)` — a NEW array with elements shifted left `k` positions, wrapping around. `RotateLeft({1,2,3,4,5}, 2)` is `{3,4,5,1,2}`. `k` larger than the length must still work; null input throws `ArgumentException`.

tests.name: basic
tests.hint: Wrap-around placement: target[(i - k mod n + n) mod n] = source[i].

tests.name: wrap-and-alias
tests.hint: k is taken modulo length; and the result must be independent — mutating it may not touch the input.
